scope_limits: This proves stored-byte integrity and dry dependency resolution, not a numerical rollout or engineering accuracy.

Nine external logical references use exact small source/JSON members inside already saved archives whose member names contain operator/formal. No live formal tree was read or written; every materialization target is inside the ten nonformal development directories.
The script requires earlier saved archives to be separately extracted or the published repository restored; ZIP files themselves are not accepted as --external-root directories.
The five synthetic NPZ were streamed only as opaque bytes and remain non-reference software-test fixtures.
The original three legacy runs did not emit modern work/event/stage_commit traces; no new traces were inferred.
No restore was executed. Static guards and source-resolution preconditions were checked under the trusted frozen manifest and normal non-concurrent recovery workflow.
Invoke the bundled restore utility with ordinary Python and assertions enabled; python -O disables its safety checks and is outside the reviewed workflow.

Use a clean isolated recovery destination without preexisting directory symlinks. The utility checks resolved targets remain inside destination, but does not separately prevent a symlink from pointing into another subtree such as destination/operator/formal.
The static guards are not a concurrency or adversarial-filesystem transaction guarantee; do not materialize this supplement over an active experiment.
